fields.System.Title: RET-502 — Return rate by customer
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a commercial manager, I want to see which customers return the most, so that genuine
quality issues, over-ordering, and possible fraud can be told apart.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get returns as a percentage of units shipped, per customer.
  • - Given a customer, then I can see their reason breakdown and their blind-return rate.
  • - Given customers with low volume, then they are excluded from the ranking.
  • - Given a customer whose returns are mostly "no reason given" or blind, then they are
  • flagged for review.
  • - Given the report, then it identifies patterns; it does not take action.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, outbound |
| Tables | return rate projection |
| Risks | Acting on small-sample noise |
| Tests | integration |
